scripts.vercel-build: cd backend && npm install && npx prisma generate && npx prisma db push && npx tsx prisma/seed.ts && cd ../frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build: cd backend && npm install && npx prisma generate && cd ../frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.install:all: npm run install:backend && npm run install:frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
